description: Evidence-backed Phase 3 benchmark dataset. Version 2 preserves every question, taxonomy value and original claim wording from version 1, and adds per-claim verification records mapped to directly inspected primary sources.
methodology_disclaimer: Structural and factual verification only. Claim statuses describe the degree to which the original wording is supported by the cited sources as inspected on 2026-11-12. verification_metadata.verifier: OpenCode verification agent (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free)
verification_metadata.methodology: Every claim wording was preserved verbatim. Each claim was compared with the exact meaning of directly inspected primary sources. A URL alone was never treated as sufficient evidence. Claim statuses use the five-state vocabulary below; question flags are aggregated from the claim records.
verification_metadata.source_inspection_policy: Prefer peer-reviewed papers, standards, official project documentation, government publications and vendor technical documentation. Record URL, title, publisher, publication/version date, access date and inspection notes for every source.

status_definitions.verified: The claim's exact meaning is supported by the cited source(s).
status_definitions.partially_supported: The core of the claim is supported but a qualifier, number or generalisation is not.
status_definitions.contradicted: At least one material part of the claim is contradicted by the cited source(s).
status_definitions.needs_more_evidence: No inspected primary source establishes the claim; further evidence is required.
status_definitions.time_sensitive: The claim was accurate for a stated date/version but may change.

verification_metadata.aggregation_rule: A question is verified only when every claim is verified. Otherwise the question status is contradicted if any claim is contradicted, else needs_more_evidence if any claim needs more evidence, else time_sensitive if any claim is time-sensitive, else partially_supported.
